summary: Prepare internal concrete step reviewer independence validation with no user-visible effect

replay.detail: No replay, claims or projections change; the helper only reads a caller-owned snapshot.

rules.detail: No active gate policy changes. Agent review remains rejected by public mission parsers.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client or human policy change. Internal validation collects resolved step contributors and refuses unknown ownership.

downtime.detail: No production dispatch calls the new helper; no runtime or restart-time effect.

recovery.detail: Revert removes an unused internal helper and its tests; no data recovery is needed.
